items.subject: Updates to your branded content toolkit on YouTube
items.summary: YouTube outlines new branded content disclosure labels and automated detection tools.
items.body:
Supporting your brand partnerships on YouTube

We know brand partnerships are critical for growing your business. To help you maintain transparency with viewers, we've introduced several features that streamline how you disclose paid content.

These updates include refreshed, viewer-facing labels for branded content, as well as age and location controls. We're also starting to roll out automated detection for undeclared brand deals and may start auto-labeling content we detect as paid promotion that wasn't declared.

As a creator, you are responsible for ensuring your branded content is properly disclosed and follows our policies and all legal regulatory requirements.
